title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1276: Eve of alliance (3)

section.p: Grandstar City.
A month had passed. After taking a deep inhalation, Su Yu opened his eyes as a storm of source qi raged around him. He had grown even more after spending a month in seclusion.

He had reached sixty-eight body forgings, but his yang acupoint was still troubling him. Fortunately, he was rich enough with heavenearth profound light and heavenly source qi that he could sustain the acupoint’s hunger for a time even without death qi. He was no longer that far away from completing his seventy-two forgings.
“It’s another end of year…”

Su Yu muttered to himself as he recalled that year 351 was coming to an end. At this time the previous year, he had left Great Xia. In the blink of an eye, a year had passed. Soon, he would spend his second new year alone. This time, he would celebrate the new year in the ancient city. In but a few days, he would be twenty in age.

With some melancholy, he walked out of his cultivation chamber. When he reached the main hall of the residence, he spread his senses about and noted that the city was bustling with people, giving the city a much livelier atmosphere. Not long after his arrival, an old man appeared.
The old man appeared frail, but his willpower seemed powerful. As the old man looked at Su Yu, he said, “Young Friend Su, I’ve reached a decision. I will be converting into a resident.”
“Are you sure, Senior Wang?”

Senior Wang nodded, “Yes. I’m an old man without long to live. Thanks to you, I survived the previous battle. The Knowledge Seeking Realm is no more. Even if I were to return to the Human Realm, where could I go?”

Senior Wang sighed and said, “I will die sooner or later. I might as well convert into an ancient city resident. At least here, I will enjoy your backing. I can see that the city still lacks an official in charge of the gates. I volunteer for this position. With me, you will be able to better monitor the traffic in and out of the city.”

Su Yu warned, “Senior Wang, becoming a resident is not a good thing. You have just regrown your body while your sea of willpower is still damaged. If you convert into a resident now, you might die in only a few years.”
Senior Wang smiled, “Death is coming for me either way. At the very least, I can do something to help before that as a resident.”
Su Yu thought about it and asked, “Are you sure you don’t want to return?”

“No.” Senior Wang sighed, “Those from my generation have either advanced into Invincibles or died. Not many of my friends are left in the world. I will never be able to understand Invincibles. After many years of seclusion, I can’t even follow the thoughts of the regular people anymore. What’s the point of returning if I’ll still be all alone?”
Su Yu considered and said, “If that is what you wish for, you may convert into a resident. As for the death qi of the city, don’t worry. The burden on you will be light.”
Senior Wang smiled, “Since you don’t object, I’ll start my conversion. I’m near my limits in the city anyway.”

At his age, he had given up on progressing in his cultivation. After his recent near-death experience and survival thanks to Su Yu, he had decided to help Su Yu with his remaining time in the world. Su Yu might not be able to go much further than the mayor’s residence relying on himself.
At his peak, Senior Wang was near the ninth-stage Sunmoon Realm. But due to his injuries, his strength had dropped to the point where even challenging a seventh-stage Sunmoon might prove difficult.

Senior Wang said, “In that case, I’ll be addressing you as the mayor from now on. As a resident, I will require your backing. By the way, a lot of new faces have entered the city recently. I suspect they are here to spy on you…”
Su Yu nodded, “These are probably some weaklings. Very few of them are experts. Looks like everyone is afraid of losing their experts to me if I decide to seal the city again.”
“True. There is no Sunmoon among the newcomers and only a few of them are Mountainseas.”
Su Yu laughed, “They are probably here for the coming assembly. Looks like we can expect some trouble during the assembly.”

He shook his head, “These people will most definitely try to stir some trouble during the assembly. That includes some of the mayors. In fact, it is likely that some of these newcomers are here for those mayors. A lot of people are unwilling to see me gather more power in the Allheaven Battlefield. I’m not surprised.”
Senior Wang asked, “Do you have an answer to their potential challenge, Mayor?”

“An answer…” Su Yu thought about it and smiled, “There is no rush. They still need to rely on me. Without me, they won’t receive the backing of their guardians. And without their guardians, they are nothing.”

Su Yu wasn’t too worried. It was likely that the alliance would be formed. And these people wouldn’t dare to exclude him completely. After all, he was the source of the greatest backing the alliance could hope to get. Thus, they would probably try to include him while restricting his power.
Su Yu was certain some would propose numerous power-sharing systems to limit his power in the alliance. But he was not optimistic of their chances.

He was the sole person capable of encouraging the stone statues to act. He would not share any of his power unless he was stupid. As for the disobedient mayors, well, he would naturally think of a way to subdue them.

Then again, none of these mayors were weak. Even the weakest among them would be a ninth-stage Sunmoon while the stronger ones were Pseudo Invincibles. They could even fuse with the death spirits in their cities for more power. It wouldn’t be easy for Su Yu to handle them.

With sixty-eight body forgings completed, he could muster the strength of over 1.2 million acupoints. With his yang acupoint, characters, and semi-transformed source qi, he was not an opponent to scoff at. But without consuming blood essence, his combat strength would not exceed the sixth-stage Sunmoon Realm. That was far from enough to deal with these mayors.

It also wouldn’t be easy for him to convince the stone statue to act against the other mayors. Thus, he had to use reason if he wanted to deal with them. Su Yu kept convincing himself that he was a reasonable person, he naturally had to convince them through reason.

At worst, he could withdraw completely from the alliance or start a smaller alliance with only those supportive of his leadership. It was no big deal. Did those idiots believe that he couldn’t function without all thirty-six cities under him?
Su Yu said, “Senior Wang, since you’re willing to become a resident, I won’t stop you. I will need to trouble you with the affairs of this city in the future.”

This would only benefit him. It would be very hard for Senior Wang to recover from his past injuries even if he were to remain as a human. Su Yu wondered if he could think of a way to help after Senior Wang’s conversion.
Senior Wang nodded and withdrew from the hall. With his strength, a Pseudo Invincible death spirit or Xing Yue herself would be required to complete the conversion.
Su Yu was curious. Would Xing Yue show herself again? He was starting to miss her now that she had gone missing for some time.

Since he had not killed anyone in the city, Xing Yue did not have the right to kill him. Thus, he had no reason to fear her. Instead, he wanted to ask her if he could convert her back to life instead. After all, he had heard that with a connection, either of them could convert the other.

If he could convert Xing Yue back to life, would that make her his subordinate? That was what he truly cared about. After all, Xing Yue was an Invincible. Wouldn’t it be great if he could get an Invincible as a subordinate?

Thus far, the Invincibles who had helped him had only done so due to his persuasion. He did not have a subordinate Invincible who would truly follow his orders. Through the coming assembly, he wished to reach an agreement with the other stone statues.

It was also time for him to fulfill his promise of becoming the new mayor of Empyrean Cloud City. He felt like he could assume the mayorship of several ancient cities. As far as he was concerned, the stone statue was the only thing that mattered for each ancient city. The ambitions of an ancient city mayor would not matter unless they could forge a connection with the stone statue of the city.
